mapper.sql: id, teacher_id, teacher_name, lab_name, location, planned_quota, research_direction, contact, resume_file_id, created_at, updated_at

where.if: AND ( l.lab_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.teacher_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.research_direction LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT FROM lab_info WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE lab_info SET teacher_name = #{teacherName}, lab_name = #{labName}, location = #{location}, planned_quota = #{plannedQuota}, research_direction = #{researchDirection}, contact = #{contact}, resume_file_id = #{resumeFileId} WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId}
mapper.select:
SELECT l.id, l.lab_name, l.location, l.teacher_id, l.teacher_name, l.research_direction, l.planned_quota, l.contact, l.resume_file_id, ( SELECT SUM(l2.planned_quota) FROM lab_info l2 WHERE l2.lab_name = l.lab_name AND l2.location = l.location ) AS lab_total_quota FROM lab_info l
ORDER BY l.lab_name ASC, l.teacher_name ASC, l.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT DISTINCT research_direction FROM lab_info ORDER BY research_direction ASC

SELECT t.teacher_id, t.teacher_name, t.lab_name, t.location, t.research_direction, t.planned_quota, t.remaining_quota FROM ( SELECT l.teacher_id, l.teacher_name, l.lab_name, l.location, l.research_direction, l.planned_quota, CAST(l.planned_quota AS SIGNED) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM final_admission fa WHERE fa.teacher_id = l.teacher_id) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM offer o WHERE o.teacher_id = l.teacher_id AND o.status = 'PENDING' AND o.confirm_deadline > #{now}) AS remaining_quota FROM lab_info l ) t WHERE t.remaining_quota > 0 ORDER BY t.teacher_name ASC, t.teacher_id ASC
